subject: Approve discretionary onboarding credit for PLG signup — Elluminate proof-of-value
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Request: discretionary PLG onboarding credit for Elluminate (>$50k)

Team — looping you in for a quick approval. Prospect: Elluminate AI (Samir Shah, head of ML). They just completed an internal eval and want a 90-day hosted trial to validate a multi-channel assistant that will be customer-facing. Current PLG signup would hit token limits quickly.

Why this is escalated:
- Expected P0 opportunity: product maps directly to a $350k ARR opportunity if they move from PoC to paid production in 6–9 months.
- They asked for ~60k USD in free credits (we estimate ~45–55M tokens) to cover realistic usage for 90 days.
- They're self-serve but requested a one-time top-up; our standard self-serve cap is $5k.

Attachments: proposal_elluminate_credit_calc.xlsx (token math, ARR assumptions)

Requested ask: Discretionary one-time credit of $60,000, issued against RDW-DEAL-89234, 90-day expiry from issuance, token cap at 60M tokens, no change to SLA or contractual terms.

Risk controls I propose:
- Issue via ops with a strict token cap and automated alert at 80% consumption.
- Require a short mutual action plan (MAP) milestone schedule and monthly check-ins for the 90 days.
- No additional concessions (no custom pricing, no longer-term commitments yet).

If we approve, ops will issue and I will send the external confirmation + receipt. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if anyone wants the quick dossier.

Thanks —
Vivek
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivk@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary PLG onboarding credit for Elluminate (>$50k)

Vivek — thanks for the context and the attachment. A couple of operational items before I can process in Ops:
- Please confirm HubSpot deal link and that the contact email is verified (I see HS-89234 in the proposal link you sent).
- We need a signed approval_form_signed_stub.pdf for audit; I can circulate the template once sign-off is given.
- Suggest adding a hard TTL in the credit issuance (e.g., 90 days from activation) and an expiration auto-revocation if they exceed agreed usage patterns.

If Finance signs off, Ops will enforce token caps via tenant-level quotas.

Laura
RevOps Manager | Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary PLG onboarding credit for Elluminate (>$50k)

+1 to Vivek. Elluminate looks strategic for Q1: they have enterprise workflows and an integration partner that could net additional seats. I recommend we approve with the controls Laura outlined.

Suggested approval language for sign-off: "Approve a one-time promotional credit of $60,000 (USD) to Elluminate AI, to be issued as tenant credits with a 90-day expiry, hard token cap at 60M tokens, automatic alerting at 80% usage, and mandatory MAP milestone reporting every 30 days. No change to standard terms or SLAs."

Marissa — can you provide final leadership approval? If we get that today, Ops can issue tomorrow morning and Vivek can inform the buyer immediately.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 13:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary PLG onboarding credit for Elluminate (>$50k)

Team — flagged a few finance points:
- Precedent: approving $60k self-serve credits is above our usual discretionary band. We should confirm whether this will be logged as a marketing promo or contra-revenue for GAAP treatment. Ops/Accounting will need the correct tagging.
- Forecast: please attach the ARR conversion assumptions (Vivek, looks like you included it but confirm probability of close).
- Requesting an explicit ROI note: expected first-year ARR, expected conversion rate, any co-sell/partner uplift.

If we get those, I can sign-off for finance contingent on RevOps tagging and a written MAP. Otherwise would need a CFO-level approval.

Aditya Rao
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 6 Dec 2026 16:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: discretionary PLG onboarding credit for Elluminate (>$50k)

All — after reviewing the attachment and the channel partner notes, I approve the request under the controls proposed. Finance note acknowledged — tag as promo expense and RevOps to add GAAP contra revenue flagging.

Approval (final): Approve one-time promotional credit of USD 60,000 for Elluminate AI. Terms: 90-day expiry from issuance, tenant-level quota cap = 60,000,000 tokens, alert at 80%, MAP milestones monthly, no additional commercial concessions.

Ops: please issue credits under RDW-DEAL-89234 and attach approval_form_signed_stub.pdf to the record. Once issued, Vivek to send confirmation and credit_receipt_elluminate_20261207.pdf to the buyer.

Marissa Cole
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
To: Samir Shah <samir@elluminate.ai>, procurement@elluminate.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 Dec 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Elluminate — confirmation of issued promotional credit (RDW-DEAL-89234)

Samir — great to move this over the line. Per our internal approvals, Redwood has issued a one-time promotional credit of USD 60,000 to your Elluminate tenant. Summary below and attached receipt.

Credit details:
- Amount: $60,000 (USD)
- Token cap: 60,000,000 tokens
- Validity: 90 days from issuance (expires 2026-03-07 11:42:00 PST)
- Alerts: automated at 80% consumption and hard stop at cap
- MAP: we will expect a 30-day check-in and a 60-day summary; please confirm your preferred dates.

Attachments: credit_receipt_elluminate_20261207.pdf

Next steps for you: please acknowledge receipt and share a preferred time for the first 30-day check-in. Per the approval, there are no changes to standard terms or SLAs.

Thanks for the partnership — looking forward to the trial results.

—
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172
